notes.title: Projects for 2025
notes.content:
Hi all!

I would like to share some information on the new projects that are planned for this year and on which the development is already ongoing. There are two projects planned for this year (depending on the development time, one might be pushed back onto early 2026, but that remains to be seen).

The first one, the shorter project, is as was mentioned before, the final 3rd part to Cold Verdict series which will serve as a conclusion to the story. Another familiar face from the first game will now return in this one...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43584035/4bcff9b719529106888b1d32bf57596e2fde68e5.jpg[/img]

The second project, which will be longer and bigger, is going to be set in a post-apocalyptic near future world, mainly taking place inside an underground sanctuary. We'll play the role of a volunteer for a gene therapy experiment to make humans able to survive in the new world. Similarly to Interim Crossroads, this VN will have some character stats to keep track of, which will unlock some new options during the in-game choices. Another major element in the story-telling here is that we'll get a choice of our main character being male or female at the start, and this will have an effect on how others will treat you, as well as the available romance options, and even some endings will be possible only with either male or female.
For now there's no title for this project, but once there is a decision on that, I'll mention it in one of the updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43584035/a1e9d79695945dd0541c9e8da11a1f8e6067756a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43584035/17584d31eee61e0f586f9018f314cadaf423ae48.jpg[/img]

Thank you for the support! Let's hope this year will prove to be a positive year on all fronts!

notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a long time since the last news announcement, but wanted to mention that a new visual novel project I've been working on over the past year now has its own Steam Page. Interim Crossroads is a VN set in a purgatory dimension, containing choices with consequences, romance and trust building, and a whooping 16 story endings!

notes.title: Summer Dates (Gwen, Hesper, Anrid) are now available!
notes.content:
Hello once again, you wonderful people!

As promised in the announcement last week, the 3 summer dates are now available to play through! Please make sure your game has updated before launching it (the update size is just over 300 MB). These 3 dates are slightly longer than the previous ones and should hopefully be just as enjoyable as the original ones, if not more.

The new dates are the following:

Gwen Silvas (in Easy Dates)
Hesper Tremblay (in Advanced Dates)
Anrid of Keval (in Tough Dates)

Also added are 5 new Steam achievements to go along with these new dates!

Thank you for supporting the game and please feel free to share any feedback you have.

notes.title: Identities of the Upcoming Summer Dates Revealed!
notes.content:
Following on from the previous announcement last month, I thought perhaps now is the best time to finally reveal the identities of the 3 new dates that will be added to the game in summer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43584035/fac14e2b2207813eba5d52fb56b99ad45961d069.png[/img]

Gwen (on the left)
No surprises there. She's been requested by several people and was initially planned for the game. If you've already played through "Holiday with Gwen", you know what to expect from a date with her. A date with her pretty much can't go wrong.

Hesper (in the middle)
One of the heroines from an older game series of ours - the Incitement trilogy. Hesper is a smart, geeky girl who is exceptionally good with machines, gadgets and computers, as well as piloting spaceships. Having lost one of her eyes during a workplace accident, she now has a synthetic eye instead of an eyepatch.

Anrid (on the right)
One of the protagonists from the Atonement series. Anrid is a disciplined, determined and highly athletic fighter who can stand her ground against any foe whilst also possessing the knowledge of some useful healing spells. Her job being a guard is not easy in a world full of deadly wild beasts and supernatural horrors.

Thanks again to everyone for the love and attention given to this game so far. Keep an eye out for further announcements and updates, and please feel free to let us know what you liked or disliked about the game.

notes.title: Three New Dates in Summer
notes.content:
Hello fellow charmers, date connoisseurs and erotica enthusiasts!

Thanks to everyone who has tried out the game and especially everyone who's enjoyed it and given feedback. Despite currently not having many reviews, the game has gotten a pretty good amount of attention already. This has confirmed what I was hoping to do from the start, and that is to add new dates  to the game with new women over time. So, without further ado, this news is to let you all know that three new dates (one for each difficulty) will be added to the game as a free update sometime closer to summer. The identity of the dates will be fully revealed at a later time.
